stories.title: H.C. Wainwright reiterates Buy rating on Agomab Therapeutics

stories.whyItMatters: The reiteration signals continued analyst confidence in Agomab, a clinical-stage biotech, though it offers investors little new information.

stories.title: Guggenheim cuts Netflix price target to $78 after ad revenue miss
stories.summary: Guggenheim lowered its stock price target on Netflix to $78. The firm cited a miss in Netflix's advertising revenue. The report gave no further detail on the size of the miss.
stories.whyItMatters: Netflix's ad-tier business is a key growth driver for investors, so a revenue miss there raises questions about the pace of that expansion.
whatToWatch: Netflix's next earnings report for ad revenue trends.
Whether other analysts follow with similar cuts.
questions: How large was the ad revenue miss?
Does the shortfall affect Netflix's subscriber growth outlook?

stories.title: JPMorgan trims price targets on Corning and GE Aerospace over valuation
stories.summary: JPMorgan cut its stock price target on Corning, citing valuation concerns. The firm also lowered its target on GE Aerospace, citing valuation pressure. Both cuts came the same day.
stories.whyItMatters: The cuts suggest JPMorgan sees both stocks priced above what their fundamentals support, a signal for investors weighing further upside.
whatToWatch: New price targets or ratings from other banks on both stocks.
Corning's and GE Aerospace's next earnings reports.
questions: What specific valuation metrics drove JPMorgan's cuts?
Did JPMorgan change its underlying rating, or only the price target?

stories.title: JPMorgan sees strategic logic in a potential SpaceX-Tesla merger

stories.title: UBS turns bearish on Maersk over shipping glut risk
stories.summary: UBS turned bearish on Maersk stock. The firm warned that a glut of ships threatens freight rates and profits at the container shipping company. The report gave no specific rating or price target detail.
stories.whyItMatters: Maersk is a key indicator of global trade conditions, so a warning on freight rates signals wider pressure on shipping industry profits.
whatToWatch: Freight rate trends in the container shipping market.
Maersk's next earnings report for margin impact.
questions: How large is the ship oversupply UBS is flagging?
